about: The explainer move for every worked step of every built method (FAL-425). Key: type/unknown/angle. Under it, one list per step count (or per representation and step count, as words/4, where that rep lines up differently), with one move ID from moves.json, or null when no move fits, per step index. branches give the move for a step whose numbers take another route at the same step count, matched by a pattern in the step text. Built from game/tools/export_questions.gd; check with node tools/moves.mjs --coverage <questions.json>. See curriculum/README.md.
